question: Which of the following cities hosted the first Khelo India Fencing Women's League in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **New Delhi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first Khelo India Fencing Women's League in July 2022 was held in New Delhi and Patiala. 
 
• **New Delhi:** Hosted the first two phases of the league. <
